text: Software testing plays a vital role in building reliable applications. Unit tests check small pieces of code, like individual functions, to ensure they work correctly. Integration tests go further by verifying that different parts of the system interact smoothly together. Many developers follow test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about requirements and design. While testing requires extra effort, it gives teams confidence to make changes or add new features without breaking existing functionality. In short, a well-tested codebase saves time and prevents unpleasant surprises in production.
